#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
long long power[20];
int minSteps;

long long mostSignificantDigit(long long num, int &digitCount) {
    digitCount = 0;
    while (num >= 10) {
        num /= 10;
        digitCount++;
    }
    return num;
}

void search(long long value, int steps) {
    if (steps >= minSteps) return;
    if (value == 0) {
        minSteps = steps;
        return;
    }
    int len;
    long long msd = mostSignificantDigit(value, len);
    
    // Option 1: subtract t * (10^len - 1)/9 * t
    search(abs(value - power[len] * msd), steps + msd * (len + 1));
    
    // Option 2: subtract (t-1) * repunit
    if (msd - 1 > 0) {
        search(abs(value - power[len] * (msd - 1)), steps + (msd - 1) * (len + 1));
    }
    
    // Option 3: jump to next repunit
    if (msd > 1) {
        search(abs(power[len + 1] - value), steps + (len + 2));
    }
}

int main() {
    long long n;
    scanf("%lld", &n);
    power[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 18; i++) {
        power[i] = power[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    minSteps = INT_MAX;
    search(n, 0);
    printf("%d\n", minSteps);
    return 0;
}
